articles.title: AIG to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results on February 10, 2026, and Host Conference Call on February 11, 2026
articles.mainIdea: AIG to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results on February 10, 2026, and Host Conference Call on February 11, 2026
articles.summary: Business Wire: AIG to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results on February 10, 2026, and Host Conference Call on February 11, 2026. NEW YORK, January 16, 2026--American International Group, Inc. (NYSE: AIG) will report financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025, after the market closes on Tuesday, February 10, 2026. AIG’s press release and financial supplement will be available in the Investors section of AIG’s website at https://www.aig.com.

articles.title: ACORD Announces 2026 Board of Directors
articles.summary: PR Newswire: ACORD Announces 2026 Board of Directors. ACORD, the global standards-setting body for the insurance industry, today announced its 2026 Board of Directors. The ACORD Board will be chaired by Robert Kelly AM (Founder, Managing Director & CEO, Steadfast Group Limited), with Kevin Tobin (Outside Director) serving as Vice Chair. The Board consists of 18 members, including seven new Directors. Related tickers mentioned: SFGLF.
